notes:
User is planning a tropical dinner party and enjoys experimenting with cocktails and jerk seasoning. Menu:
- Appetizers: grilled pineapple/prosciutto skewers; spicy shrimp ceviche.
- Main: grilled jerk chicken with mango salsa.
- Side: roasted sweet potatoes seasoned with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic/onion, with optional citrus.
- Dessert: coconut-lime panna cotta topped with a separate dessert mango salsa—riper/very sweet, mild or no chile, balanced lime, optional honey/agave and fresh herb; suggested 2 mangos, ½ red onion, ¼ cup cilantro, 2 tbsp lime, optional sweetener and Grand Marnier.

Cocktail interests:
- Enjoys sweet, spicy, tangy, creamy, tropical flavors with refreshing contrast.
- Has a cocktail-making class on Fridays and is excited to experiment with recipes, ingredients, ratios, garnishes, and techniques.
- Developing a Watermelon Basil Margarita using Avion Silver, their favorite tequila. Plan: roast watermelon to intensify/caramelize sweetness, then purée. Existing draft: 2 oz tequila, 1 oz lime, ½ oz watermelon purée, ½ oz agave, ¼ oz basil syrup, ice, salt rim; garnish with watermelon and basil. Homemade basil syrup: 1:1 water/sugar steeped with ¼ cup basil. Adjust watermelon and basil to taste; possible grapefruit/orange juice, jalapeño, or sparkling element.
- Plans to make the Paloma and a tequila sour (egg-white drink with lime and orange liqueur) during Friday’s class. Especially wants to experiment with grapefruit juice and compare pink/ruby varieties. Possible citrus- or spice-infused syrup variation for the sour.
- Earlier also liked ideas such as cucumber-lime refresher, jalapeño-pineapple spritz, grapefruit-ginger fizz, cantaloupe agua fresca, and spicy mango mule.

Previous notes said Thursday, but class is now Friday.
trajectory:
User is planning a dinner party featuring spicy mango margaritas and tropical flavors. Selected menu:
- Appetizers: grilled pineapple and prosciutto skewers; spicy shrimp ceviche.
- Main: grilled jerk chicken with mango salsa.
- Side: roasted sweet potatoes (chosen instead of quinoa and grilled asparagus), likely seasoned with olive oil, salt, pepper, and aromatics such as garlic/onion, with optional lime or orange for citrus.
- Dessert: coconut-lime panna cotta topped with dessert-friendly mango salsa.

For the dessert salsa, user asked whether to reuse the chicken’s salsa and received guidance to make a separate, sweeter and less spicy version: more ripe mango, less or no chile, balanced lime, optional honey/agave, and a fresh herb such as mint, basil, or cilantro. Suggested base: 2 diced ripe mangos, 1/2 diced red onion, 1/4 cup chopped cilantro, 2 tbsp lime juice, optional 1 tbsp honey/agave, and salt; optional Grand Marnier.

User enjoys experimenting with jerk seasoning and likes its flavor on chicken. They have a cocktail-making class on Thursday and are excited to try new recipes and techniques. They may later want cocktail ideas, pairing help, or party-planning assistance. Overall taste favors sweet, spicy, tangy, creamy, and tropical combinations, with refreshing contrast after spicy food.
